title: Design Improved Hero Section Layout and Content
description: Create a revised design for the hero section, enhancing visual hierarchy, clarity, and marketing impact.
details: Based on analysis, draft a new layout (wireframe or Figma/Sketch if available) that improves headline, subheadline, call-to-action (CTA), and supporting visuals. Ensure accessibility (WCAG AA), mobile responsiveness, and alignment with project branding. Specify any new assets (images, icons) required.
test_strategy: Review design with stakeholders or against project branding guidelines. Validate accessibility and responsiveness in design mockups.

title: Implement Improved Hero Section in Codebase
description: Update the relevant component(s) to reflect the new hero section design, including layout, content, and styling.
details: Modify the identified hero section file(s) using React (Next.js) and Tailwind CSS. Update text, CTA buttons, and visuals as per the new design. Ensure semantic HTML, ARIA attributes for accessibility, and responsive design for all screen sizes. Import any new assets as needed.
test_strategy: Manually test the hero section in local development across devices and browsers. Use accessibility tools (axe, Lighthouse) to verify compliance. Peer review code for maintainability.

title: Refactor and Optimize Hero Section Code
description: Refactor the hero section code for maintainability, performance, and reusability.
details: Extract repeated elements into smaller components if needed. Remove unused code and optimize asset loading (e.g., lazy loading images). Ensure Tailwind classes are not duplicated. Add comments where necessary for clarity. Confirm that the hero section does not negatively impact dashboard load times.
test_strategy: Run performance profiling (Lighthouse, Chrome DevTools). Check bundle size impact. Confirm code passes linting and code review standards.

title: Test and Validate Improved Hero Section
description: Conduct comprehensive testing of the improved hero section to ensure quality and alignment with requirements.
details: Perform cross-browser and device testing. Validate accessibility (screen reader, keyboard navigation). Solicit stakeholder feedback for final approval. Write or update unit and integration tests (Jest/React Testing Library) for the hero section component(s).
test_strategy: Verify all acceptance criteria are met. Run automated and manual tests. Address any bugs or UX issues found during testing.

title: Analyze Current Hero Section Implementation
description: Review the existing hero section in the marketing-dashboard-starter repository to identify structure, styling, and content.
details: Locate the hero section component (likely in the main landing page or a dedicated Hero.js/tsx file). Analyze its current layout, content, styling (Tailwind CSS), and responsiveness. Document any shortcomings in clarity, visual appeal, accessibility, or alignment with marketing goals. Identify which files and components will require modification.
test_strategy: Confirm that the analysis covers all hero section elements. Validate findings by comparing with design/UX best practices and project requirements.
